spec.source: research/fulltext/P24.pdf, PDF page 9, Table I Panel A column Mkt; equations 1-3 on pages 6-7
spec.sample: August 1926 through April 2015; exact endpoint inferred from 1065 observations starting after July 1926 variance. Not independently certified from author replication code.
spec.data: Monthly French July-2015 archive; daily CRSP vwretd minus French RF in author teaching snapshot from April 2021, ending December 2020. Not the original daily FF market-factor vintage.
spec.estimator: Monthly factor excess return divided by prior calendar-month daily excess-return variance (population denominator). Full-target-sample standard-deviation normalization for descriptive reproduction only. OLS managed excess return on original factor and constant.
spec.inference: HC1 primary, HC0 and Bartlett Newey-West six monthly lags sensitivity. Paper states heteroskedasticity adjustment but not exact finite-sample variant.
spec.primary_endpoint: Annualized alpha; beta, SE, R-squared and N are replication diagnostics, not independent discoveries.
spec.decision: At best partial reproduction: known data mismatch precludes exact. Numerically close if N=1065, alpha within 0.50 pp/year, beta within .05, alpha SE within .25 pp/year and R2 within .05. These are descriptive approximation tolerances, not equivalence tests. Otherwise mark inconclusive discrepancy unless audited exact inputs support inconsistency.
spec.tolerance_reason: Approximately 10% of reported alpha, 8% of beta and 16% of alpha SE; fixed practical diagnostics for known data differences, not rounding tolerances.
spec.power_note: Normal 80%-power two-sided alpha MDE approximated by (1.96+.84)*robust SE; descriptive precision only, data-dependent.
spec.tradeability: No fees, leverage limits or causal scaling normalization. No economic signal verdict or fresh confirmation.
